notes.title: 🎮 Playing Through My First Game – Stream Replay Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I recently streamed a full playthrough of the very first game I ever made, and the recording is now live on Twitch!

📺 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2433472735]Watch Replay[/url]

If you're curious what my early work looked like, or just want to see how it all started, this is a fun and raw look at where I began as a game developer. 

Thanks for all the support—and stay tuned, more streams (and new content) coming soon!

notes.title: Weapon descriptions update
notes.notes:
The weapon descriptions now all show their damage in the description, like the skill descriptions of the weapons already did.
Additionally, the military instructor, Banz, hands out a damage type manual in the training program in the early game. This key item explains the different damage types in reference to the armor stat and additional armor resistances.

notes.title: Group invisibility ability change + bugfix
notes.notes:
- Group invisibility now prevents enemy encounters
- stopped recovery in a hidden dungeon

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with the skilltree and vehicle interaction. You stay in the vehicle after opening a skilltree now
- Opening an Ammo Clip opens all Ammo clips at once now and reopens the menu.

notes.title: Fall discount and new social media channels
notes.notes:
Fall has arrived in PoW too! From the 15th until the 21st October PoW will be sold at a big discount.


Thanks to early buyers' feedback, PoW has already improved in gameplay and some wanted dialogue has been added.

If you have questions or feedback too, you can do so here or on our brand-new discord channel:

https://discord.gg/9zDDfeAy


Also, watch our brand-new gameplay introduction video on YouTube!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KCoTZW-xSec

notes.title: Smoke grenade skill loss Bugfix
notes.notes:
-If you used the smoke grenade previously, all passive abilities like wearing armor have been removed. This is fixed now.
If you have already lost abilities due to this bug and don't want to spend the Skillpoints again, you can go to the "Free your mind Master", which is a teacher which you can find, for example, in Teliois in the training area. There you can reset all skills for money.

- Additional Arena dialogues have been added

- A Map bug in the Kenimaarer HQ has been fixed

notes.title: Lower difficulty option
notes.notes:
-Added a menu button to lower the difficulty during a run
-added difficulty "Very Easy"

notes.title: Save file and equip menu fix
notes.notes:
Game doesn't autosave on opening and closing the menu anymore. This way the autosave doesn't get overwritten when opening another save file.

Re-added Faces to the equip menu.

notes.title: Limited Beta Access
notes.notes:
Planet of War: The Legend of Fu or, in short, PoW reached its final development stage.
Today starts a limited closed beta. You can request access to as long as there are open slots.
